answer: Admission needs a quorum spanning separate branches. The kth identity carries k signatures, each from a signer in its own dune, no two signers sharing work history with each other or with the operator, so nobody can mint his own quorum. Each signer burns ember equal to the head-count the identity brings the operator to, counted from the operator's record, so a tenth identity burns 100 ember across ten outsiders while a first burns one. The yarrow a signer stakes at that same figure is forfeit if two signers share a dune, and a replacement operator key must carry the old dune record.
